title: Cheese Rice Paper Burekas
subtitle: with cottage cheese and chives
description: Baked rice paper parcels filled with cottage cheese, yellow cheese, egg and chives, sprinkled generously with sesame and nigella seeds.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190°C. Mix all the filling ingredients (cottage cheese, grated yellow cheese, egg, chopped chives, salt and pepper) until even.
Fill a wide bowl with water and dip one rice paper sheet at a time for 10-15 seconds until soft.
Place the sheet on the work surface and put a spoonful of filling in the centre. Do not overfill or they may burst while baking.

Fold into a square and place seam side down on a tray lined with baking paper. Brush all the burekas with beaten egg and sprinkle generously with sesame and nigella seeds. Bake for about 20-25 minutes.
